# K GraphFuse

> Sparse graph polynomial plans, directional sensitivities and optional CUDA execution. Created by Utkarsh Sinha. Evaluation release 0.1.0; Apache 2.0 with preserved historical MIT components.

Measured scope: 21.28% lower warm median time versus native cuGraph on one same-T4 ten-update PageRank task. Both pass reference accuracy; aggregate L1 error is higher. Global SOTA and customer savings are unestablished. The earlier 19-workload suite passes zero strongest GPU gates.
